text: On 10 August 2026, a complaint was received that Vikram Rathore, along with his associate Ramesh Kumar, extorted money from a shopkeeper near Bhawarkuan Chowk, Indore. Rathore was seen driving vehicle MP09AB1234 and was contacted on phone number 9876543210. Witnesses stated that Ramesh Kumar frequently visits Chatterjee Traders located at Rajwada. Suresh Yadav is suspected to have transferred funds to Rathore through the account held at Rau Indore.

Surveillance team observed Ramesh Kr. meeting Farhan Ali at a highway dhaba near Dewas Naka on 12 August 2026. Farhan Ali arrived in vehicle DL1CAB1234 from Delhi. Ramesh Kr. handed over a package before returning towards Bhawarkuan Chowk. Zubair Khan called Vikram Rathore repeatedly earlier that morning from Chandan Nagar.

Vikram Rathore was seen at Sector 12 Indore in the company of Sanjay Mehta. Sanjay Mehta later visited Palasia Indore and met Deepak Verma. Om Prakash, who drives a taxi registered as MP09XY7788, dropped Deepak Verma at Rajwada Indore on 15 August 2026.

Intelligence inputs indicate that Suresh Yadav coordinates with Anita Deshmukh to route proceeds through Chatterjee Traders, a shell trading firm at Rajwada. Anita Deshmukh subsequently forwards a portion of the funds to Farhan Ali, believed to be a narcotics supplier operating out of Karol Bagh, Delhi.
